setup: node v22.13.1; one in-memory SQLite db (node:sqlite) holding both shapes; seed 21; users 10000 and 100000 (10000: complete, 100000: complete); 1000 products with 1/rank popularity; 1-9 order lines per user; interleaved pairs, order alternated, adaptive count up to 300/200/200 (profile/report/rename) within a 45 s global budget; profile samples are batches of 20 same users per shape; rename target = most popular product, equal-length names alternated; timer floor 0.0083 ms; bytes are logical content bytes, not disk pages; total 14.9 s
